design_philosophy: Nordic Industrial Tech. A highly precise, data-dense financial/predictive dashboard avoiding generic SaaS aesthetics. Prioritizes stark clarity, high-contrast structural hierarchy, and technical typography to build trust in algorithm outputs.

scales.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

grid.base_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6

surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-none shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-md
surfaces.ai_panel: relative bg-slate-900 text-white border border-slate-700 overflow-hidden rounded-none

interactive.button_primary: bg-brand-primary text-white font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-brand-primary_hover transition-colors flex items-center gap-2
interactive.button_outline: border border-slate-300 bg-transparent text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-none

entrance.item: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 10 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }

images.description: Abstract 3D glass-like data visualization background. Use this inside the Tomorrow's Prediction or AI Analysis panel as a subtle background image with low opacity (e.g., opacity-20) to add depth without compromising readability.
images.usage: bg-cover bg-center absolute inset-0 mix-blend-overlay opacity-20

images.description: Aerial view of Helsinki covered in snow. Can be used as a subtle header background or within the Regional Comparison section for flavor.
images.usage: Used in minimal banner or contextual cards.

specific_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, toggles, and significant data points MUST have descriptive, role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., 'refresh-prediction-button', 'prediction-value-95E10').
specific_guidelines.numbers: Always display units clearly. Prices in €/L. Deltas must include +/- prefix (e.g., +0.024 €/L). Use green for price drops (positive for consumer) and red for price increases.
specific_guidelines.anti_patterns: DO NOT use Inter font. DO NOT use rounded corners on primary cards (keep them sharp/flat). DO NOT center-align data tables.
